reason: Fast Landing narrow successor authorization for the second Class-B prerequisite already frozen by Product Final Controller #1051. Current trusted main has the correct durable provider-administration ownership chain route -> AiGateway._runDurableProviderAdmin -> ollamaClient.pullModel, landed by PR #637, but the active physical Ollama pull seam lost three mature reviewed #566 guards during the later Adaptive Local supersession: caller pull endpoints are not constrained to loopback/configured Ollama hosts, a 200 NDJSON stream may return ok after EOF without terminal status=success, and progress does not preserve truthful cumulative multi-layer totals with global percent unknown until terminal success. This authorization restores only those current-active physical-pull truth/safety semantics plus focused regression coverage. It does not restore the superseded Local Auxiliary scheduler/provider architecture, old System Center UI, a second model router, or any Product successor-v11 bytes.

rootCause.requiredRepair: Restore the mature physical Ollama pull boundary guards inside the existing ollamaClient.pullModel seam: authorize only loopback or configured trusted Ollama roots; fail closed with OLLAMA_PULL_INCOMPLETE unless the stream reaches terminal success; aggregate progress by digest across layers and keep global total/percent unknown until terminal success. Preserve the current AiGateway durable provider-admin owner and current route/cancellation topology.

currentMissingGuards: pullModel normalizes caller endpoint but does not restrict it to loopback or configured trusted Ollama hosts
pullModel returns ok=true after stream EOF without requiring terminal status=success
pullModel forwards row-local progress and does not aggregate multiple digest layers or reserve 100 percent for terminal success

matureSemantics: authorizedPullRoot allows loopback or exact configured Ollama roots and rejects arbitrary remote targets with OLLAMA_ENDPOINT_NOT_AUTHORIZED
empty malformed or truncated HTTP-200 pull streams fail closed unless terminal status is success, using OLLAMA_PULL_INCOMPLETE
progress aggregates known totals and completed bytes by digest across layers
nonterminal global total and percent remain unknown instead of presenting a provisional layer set as final
terminal success seals final aggregate total and percent=100

requiredBehavior: Existing /api/pull physical protocol remains the only Ollama download protocol.
Caller-supplied endpoint is accepted only when loopback or exactly present in CONFIG.ollamaHosts after normalization.
A successful HTTP response or EOF alone never means download success; terminal status success is mandatory.
Empty, malformed-only, truncated and nonterminal streams fail closed with OLLAMA_PULL_INCOMPLETE.
Progress is cumulative across digest layers; completed bytes never reset merely because a new layer appears.
Before terminal success, global total and percent remain unknown while knownTotal and completed may advance.
Terminal success returns ok=true, seals total >= completed and percent=100.
Existing caller AbortSignal and timeout semantics remain intact.
AiGateway remains the durable provider-admin owner and backend/routes/models.js remains the current HTTP lifecycle owner.
No Local Auxiliary scheduler, old System Center UI, second model router or second provider administration authority is restored.
riskSurface: arbitrary remote pull target / SSRF-like physical model fetch
false success after empty malformed or truncated HTTP-200 NDJSON
multi-layer progress reset or misleading denominator
unrelated Adaptive Local or Product behavior change
localAcceptance: Focused backend regression proves a normal trusted loopback success stream still succeeds and preserves the caller AbortSignal.
Focused backend regression rejects a non-loopback endpoint not present in CONFIG.ollamaHosts with OLLAMA_ENDPOINT_NOT_AUTHORIZED before physical fetch.
Focused backend regression proves empty, malformed-only and truncated/nonterminal HTTP-200 streams fail with OLLAMA_PULL_INCOMPLETE.
Focused backend regression proves two or more digest layers aggregate completed/knownTotal cumulatively, keep total=0 and percent=0 before success, then seal total and percent=100 only on success.
Static review confirms backend/routes/models.js still delegates to aiGateway.pullLocalModel and AiGateway still delegates through _runDurableProviderAdmin; neither file changes.
git diff --check equivalent is GREEN and changed path set is exactly the authorized two paths.
